description: This file contains unit tests for deep link security and setup code validation in the OpenClawKit project, focusing on URL parsing and validation logic to prevent insecure connections.

classes.name: DeepLinksSecurityTests
classes.description: Test suite class containing security-focused test cases for deep links.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a gateway deep link with non-loopback insecure WebSocket URL rejects the connection.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that a gateway deep link with a bypass host using non-loopback IP rejects the connection.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Verifies that a gateway deep link with a loopback address over WebSocket is accepted.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a setup code with a URL pointing to a non-loopback insecure WebSocket rejects the setup.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests rejection for setup code with bypass host IPs that are not localhost.

methods.name: setupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Verifies that a setup code with a loopback address over WebSocket is accepted.
